terminals.name: gradio-app
terminals.command: if [ -f models/model.keras ] && [ -f models/svc.pkl ]; then TF_USE_LEGACY_KERAS=1 .venv/bin/python app.py; else echo 'Models not found. Train first: run code.ipynb or `python train.py` to create models/model.keras and models/svc.pkl, then restart this terminal.'; fi
